name: Wells Castor Oil 70ml
description:
Wells Castor Oil 70ml (Made in Spain)

Experience the nourishing power of Wells Castor Oil, a premium-quality, cold-pressed oil designed for skin, hair, and nail care.

Key Benefits:

Hair Care: Helps prevent hair loss, promotes healthy, shiny hair, improves texture, and conditions the scalp.

Skin Care: Deeply moisturizes, soothes dry or irritated skin, and may reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles.

Nail Care: Strengthens and nourishes nails, reducing brittleness and supporting healthy growth.

Pure & Natural: Cold-pressed with no synthetic additives for maximum purity and effectiveness.

Usage: Ideal for daily use as a massage oil or part of your beauty and wellness routine.

Brand: Wells | Origin: Spain | Volume: 70ml

A versatile oil for holistic care – keeping your hair, skin, and nails healthy and nourished.
